fastINFLECT: Fast discovery of the metaclustering endpoint for SOM objects

Source: R/INFLECT3-package.R
fastINFLECT-package.Rd

fastINFLECT evaluates a literal schedule of metacluster counts for a FlowSOM or kohonen self-organising map. Start with INFLECT(), then use print(), plot(), and as.data.frame() to read the candidate values and tested QC pass rates.

The result retains the tested partitions, separate dip and IQR decisions, detailed cluster-marker measurements, and run provenance. Candidate values narrow the search for k; they do not establish biological validity or prove unimodality.
